releaseNotes.content:
# GIB2A VS v26.1.2-BETA

First public-preparation build of the VSpeak telemetry dashboard for FrSky ETHOS.

- Manual assignment of VSpeak telemetry sources
- Twelve VSpeak ECU status decoders
- RPM, EGT, remaining fuel, pump and ECU-status dashboard
- Pump PW for KingTech and Xicoy/Kolibri; Pump Voltage for other selections
- RX voltage, dual-band RSSI, three themes and configurable fuel alert
- Telemetry-only: no turbine or receiver control

Verify all sources and values on the target radio before flight.
